text:
sqlpipe moves rows from Postgres to S3 in three stages: a reader, a converter, and an uploader.

The reader connects to Postgres and streams rows in batches. Each batch has a fixed size that you set in the configuration. The reader sends each batch to the converter through a channel.

The converter receives one batch at a time. It maps each column to a Parquet type. Then it writes the batch as a Parquet row group in memory. When the row group is complete, the converter sends it to the uploader.

The uploader writes each row group to S3 as one part of a multipart object. If a part fails, the uploader retries the part three times. When all parts are complete, the uploader closes the multipart object.
